subject: maths
question: A single discount equivalent to a series of successive discounts, 20%, 10% and 15%, is:
solution:
Given:

Series of successive discounts, 20%, 10% and 15%.

Concept used:

Final discount percentage after two successive discounts of A% and B% = (A + B - {AB over 100})\%

Calculation:

Resultant discount after 20% and 10%

⇒ 20 + 10 - (20 × 10/100) = 28%

Final discount = 28 + 15 - (28 × 15/100) = 38.8%

**∴ A single discount equivalent to a series of successive discounts, 20%, 10% and 15%, is 38.8%.**
